name: Fly.io
how_to_set: No spending cap. Buy prepaid credits and check the bill to date near month end.
Set auto_stop_machines and min_machines_running = 0 in fly.toml.
kill_switch: fly scale count 0 (or fly machines stop) per app.
traps: Volumes and dedicated IPv4 keep billing when machines stop
Machines with auto-stop off run all month
Prepaid credits do not stop overflow charges in all cases
unverified: Whether exhausted prepaid credits suspend apps or roll into card billing; staff replies conflict
